source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: The Hour that strikes people's hearts with its terrors.
tafsir.muyassar-3: And what could make you know what it is?
tafsir.muyassar-4: On that day people, in their multitude, dispersal and movement, will be like scattered moths, which fall into the fire.
tafsir.muyassar-5: And the mountains will be like multicolored wool being carded by hand, becoming dust and vanishing.
tafsir.muyassar-6: As for the one whose scales of good deeds are heavy, he will be in a pleasing life in Paradise.
tafsir.muyassar-7: As for the one whose scales of good deeds are heavy, he will be in a pleasing life in Paradise.
tafsir.muyassar-8: And as for the one whose scales of good deeds are light and whose evil deeds outweigh, his refuge will be Hell.
tafsir.muyassar-9: And as for the one whose scales of good deeds are light and whose evil deeds outweigh, his refuge will be Hell.
tafsir.muyassar-10: And what could make you know, O Messenger, what this abyss is?
tafsir.muyassar-11: It is a fire made intensely hot by the fuel upon it.
